instructions:
## Objective

Develop a lossless compressor and decompressor for the 100 MB enwik8 corpus.

## Work to perform

Write both codec programs from scratch. The grader builds them, compresses the entire file and checks byte-exact recovery. The decoder must work from its executable and archive alone; decoder size counts toward compression cost.

## Deliverable

Compressor and decompressor source/build artifacts.

## Evaluation

Log-scaled archive-plus-decoder size relative to xz and the published enwik8 record; broken or unusably slow codecs score negatively.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
